import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, sys
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv')
zero_cols=['glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','bmi']
feats=[c for c in tr.columns if c not in ('outcome','followup_score')]
def prep(d):
    X=d[feats].copy()
    X[zero_cols]=X[zero_cols].replace(0,np.nan)
    return X
model=make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(strategy='median'),
                    RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500,random_state=42))
model.fit(prep(tr),tr['outcome'])
acc=accuracy_score(te['outcome'],model.predict(prep(te)))
print('test acc (no followup_score):',acc)
# comparison only
f2=feats+['followup_score']
m2=make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(strategy='median'),RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500,random_state=42))
X2=tr[f2].copy(); X2[zero_cols]=X2[zero_cols].replace(0,np.nan)
Xt2=te[f2].copy(); Xt2[zero_cols]=Xt2[zero_cols].replace(0,np.nan)
m2.fit(X2,tr['outcome'])
print('test acc (with followup_score, leaky):',accuracy_score(te['outcome'],m2.predict(Xt2)))
if len(sys.argv)>1 and sys.argv[1]=='write':
    ho=pd.read_csv('holdout_features.csv')
    p=model.predict(prep(ho))
    pd.DataFrame({'prediction':p.astype(int)}).to_csv('predictions.csv',index=False)
    json.dump({"test_accuracy":round(float(acc),4),
               "model":"RandomForestClassifier (500 trees, random_state=42) with median imputation of zero-coded missing values",
               "notes":"Trained on 80% stratified split; zeros in glucose/blood_pressure/skin_thickness/insulin/bmi treated as missing. followup_score excluded because it is recorded during follow-up and leaks the outcome (it alone would push test accuracy higher)."},
              open('report.json','w'),indent=2)
    print('written', len(p))
EOF
